comment:
Civil registration appears only as an illustration under the birth-event-publish-subscribe example. CRVS should be named as a foundational dependency. Legal identity established at birth is what allows a person to enter UHC beneficiary rolls, and death registration helps protect the system from “ghost patients.” 

On cybersecurity operations: Security is treated as a design principle but not as a standing operational capability that has recurring costs. A security operations and incident-response function is an institutional requirement that ministries need to secure continuous funding for.
